control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during transfer operations on P-9501

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-9501 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-9501 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 23 October 2008 an incident occurred on P-9501 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
